mapper.update: UPDATE application_saga SET status='WORKFLOW_CREATED',module_instance_id=#{moduleId},response_json=#{response},next_retry_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE saga_id=#{id} AND status='PROJECT_CREATED'
UPDATE application_saga SET status='WORKFLOW_CREATED',last_error=#{error},next_retry_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE saga_id=#{id} AND status IN ('PROJECT_CREATED','WORKFLOW_CREATED')
mapper.select: SELECT saga_id FROM application_saga WHERE status='WORKFLOW_CREATED' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE application_saga SET retry_count=retry_count+1,last_error=#{error}, next_retry_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,INTERVAL LEAST(300,POW(2,LEAST(retry_count,8))) SECOND) WHERE saga_id=#{id} AND status='WORKFLOW_CREATED'
UPDATE application_saga SET status='COMPLETED',response_json=#{response},last_error=NULL WHERE saga_id=#{id} AND status='WORKFLOW_CREATED'
UPDATE application_saga SET status='COMPENSATED',last_error=#{error} WHERE saga_id=#{id}
mapper.select: WHERE actor_user_id=#{actor} AND request_hash=#{hash} AND created_at>=#{after} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM project WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application_saga WHERE status IN ('PROJECT_CREATED','WORKFLOW_CREATED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application_saga WHERE status IN ('FAILED','COMPENSATED')
SELECT COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MIN(created_at),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),0) FROM application_saga WHERE status IN ('PROJECT_CREATED','WORKFLOW_CREATED')
